 Grizzlies' Ty Jerome: Late addition to injury report
 By
 RotoWire Staff
 Oct 29, 2026
 at
 9:16 pm ET 
 •
 1 min read
 Jerome is questionable for Thursday's game against the Trail Blazers due to back tightness.
 Jerome was added to the injury report less than one hour before tipoff, so it appears the back issue recently popped up. The team should have another update on his availability shortly.
